answer: Put every new identity on a probation island first: a separate shard where it can act but cannot vote, invite, or cash out until it completes epochs of honest work open to inspection. A single sparrow may slip onto the island, but a flock of fakes cannot graduate together without leaving matching trails, and one caught fake burns its cohort progress. The lantern of probation records makes silent farming visible. The limit is fairness: honest newcomers wait longer, and a patient attacker can still age fakes slowly, so probation must pair with random audits, not stand alone.
